label: Controls for the typed IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 readings, checked
description: Nonvacuity: both new bridges hold and a being has the nine, IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 while comprehending itself. Strictness: each new sense bridge holds where the old bridge it weakens fails (a cause of the being of all that is not infinite is not IMMENSE_1; an infinite being comprehended by a caused intellect is not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1). Necessity in these models: without either new bridge, a being with the nine is not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2. Sense mixing fails without the sense bridges: a being with the nine can be IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 and neither IMMENSE_1 nor INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; they show where each premise is needed, not that any premise is false.
